crossRefs.note: Why do the nations rage, and the peoples plot a vain thing?
The nations have sunk down in the pit that they made. In the net which they hid, their own foot is taken.
Come, let’s deal wisely with them, lest they multiply, and it happen that when any war breaks out, they also join…
Someone told David, saying, “Ahithophel is among the conspirators with Absalom.” David said, “Yahweh, please turn the…
but if you return to the city, and tell Absalom, ‘I will be your servant, O king. As I have been your father’s servant…
Absalom and all the men of Israel said, “The counsel of Hushai the Archite is better than the counsel of Ahithophel.”…
When Ahithophel saw that his counsel was not followed, he saddled his donkey, arose, and went home, to his city, and…
He frustrates the plans of the crafty, So that their hands can’t perform their enterprise.
He takes the wise in their own craftiness; the counsel of the cunning is carried headlong.
There is no wisdom nor understanding nor counsel against Yahweh.
Because Syria, Ephraim, and the son of Remaliah, have plotted evil against you, saying,
Make an uproar, you peoples, and be broken in pieces! Listen, all you from far countries: dress for battle, and be…
Take counsel together, and it will be brought to nothing; speak the word, and it will not stand, for God is with us.”
The spirit of Egypt will fail within it. I will destroy its counsel. They will seek the idols, the charmers, those who…
The princes of Zoan are utterly foolish. The counsel of the wisest counselors of Pharaoh has become stupid. How do you…
Sing, you heavens, for Yahweh has done it! Shout, you lower parts of the earth! Break out into singing, you mountains…
who frustrates the signs of the liars, and makes diviners mad; who turns wise men backward, and makes their knowledge…
For they intended evil against you. They plotted evil against you which cannot succeed.
Yahweh, don’t grant the desires of the wicked. Don’t let their evil plans succeed, or they will become proud.

translations.web: Yahweh brings the counsel of the nations to nothing. He makes the thoughts of the peoples to be of no effect.
translations.bsb: The LORD frustrates the plans of the nations; He thwarts the devices of the peoples.
translations.kjv: The LORD bringeth the counsel of the heathen to nought: he maketh the devices of the people of none effect.
translations.asv: Jehovah bringeth the counsel of the nations to nought; He maketh the thoughts of the peoples to be of no effect.
